# Build summer subjects with long titles from beaver.subject_enrollable when available; use only existing columns in subject_offered_summary
sql1 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_subjects_summer AS
SELECT 
  s.term_code,
  s.subject_id,
  COALESCE(se.subject_title_long, COALESCE(os.subject_title, s.subject_title)) AS subject_title,
  COALESCE(os.offer_dept_code, s.department_code) AS department_code,
  COALESCE(os.offer_dept_name, s.department_name) AS department_name,
  COALESCE(os.responsible_faculty_name, s.responsible_faculty_name) AS responsible_faculty_name,
  os.course_number
FROM subjects_offered s
LEFT JOIN subject_offered_summary os
  ON UPPER(os.term_code) = UPPER(s.term_code) AND os.subject_id = s.subject_id
LEFT JOIN beaver.subject_enrollable se
  ON UPPER(se.term_code) = UPPER(s.term_code) AND se.subject_id = s.subject_id
WHERE UPPER(s.term_code) LIKE '%SU%';
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql1)

# Directory (employee_directory) and roster lookups already materialized under faculty_directory and faculty_roster tables
sql2 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_directory AS
SELECT mit_id, COALESCE(directory_full_name, full_name) AS full_name, UPPER(COALESCE(directory_full_name, full_name)) AS full_name_upper, email_address, office_location
FROM faculty_directory;
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql2)

sql3 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_roster AS
SELECT fr.mit_id,
       UPPER(COALESCE(fr.last_name,'') || ', ' || COALESCE(fr.first_name,'')) AS full_name_upper
FROM faculty_roster fr;
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql3)

# Join subjects to directory via exact uppercase match; fallback to roster for MIT_ID then back to directory for email/location
sql4 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_subjects_fac AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT *, UPPER(COALESCE(responsible_faculty_name,'')) AS resp_upper FROM tmp_subjects_summer
), with_id AS (
  SELECT 
    b.*, 
    COALESCE(d.mit_id, r.mit_id) AS mit_id
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN tmp_directory d ON b.resp_upper = d.full_name_upper
  LEFT JOIN tmp_roster r ON b.resp_upper = r.full_name_upper
), with_dir AS (
  SELECT w.*, d.email_address, d.office_location
  FROM with_id w
  LEFT JOIN tmp_directory d ON w.mit_id = d.mit_id
)
SELECT term_code, subject_id, subject_title, department_code, department_name, responsible_faculty_name,
       mit_id, email_address, office_location, course_number
FROM with_dir;
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql4)

# Parse office_location variants to building_number and room; handle patterns like '7-390', 'NW32-124', 'LL-LI-217B'
sql5 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_fac_loc AS
WITH norm AS (
  SELECT *, REPLACE(UPPER(office_location), ' ', '') AS loc
  FROM tmp_subjects_fac
), parsed AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN loc LIKE '%-%' THEN SPLIT_PART(loc, '-', 1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS raw_bldg,
    CASE 
      WHEN loc LIKE '%-%' THEN SPLIT_PART(loc, '-', 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS raw_room
  FROM norm
)
SELECT 
  *,
  raw_bldg AS building_number,
  raw_room AS room_name,
  CASE WHEN raw_room ~ '^[0-9]+' THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(raw_room, '^[0-9]+') ELSE NULL END AS floor_level
FROM parsed;
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql5)

# Map building_number to long building name from facilities plus street address from buildings where possible
sql6 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_build_attrs AS
WITH fb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT building_number, building_name_long AS building_name
  FROM beaver.fac_building
), b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT building_number, building_name, building_street_address
  FROM buildings
)
SELECT COALESCE(fb.building_number, b.building_number) AS building_number,
       COALESCE(fb.building_name, b.building_name) AS building_name,
       b.building_street_address
FROM fb
FULL OUTER JOIN b USING (building_number);
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql6)

# Compute course_type proxy and department counts; final preview output
sql7 = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH typed AS (
  SELECT 
    f.term_code,
    f.subject_id,
    f.subject_title,
    f.department_code,
    f.department_name,
    f.responsible_faculty_name,
    f.email_address,
    COALESCE(ba.building_name, f.building_number) AS building_name,
    f.room_name AS room_name,
    f.floor_level,
    ba.building_street_address,
    f.course_number,
    CASE 
      WHEN f.course_number IS NOT NULL AND POSITION('.' IN f.course_number)>0 THEN LEFT(f.course_number, POSITION('.' IN f.course_number)-1)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS course_type
  FROM tmp_fac_loc f
  LEFT JOIN tmp_build_attrs ba ON f.building_number = ba.building_number
), dept_counts AS (
  SELECT department_code, COUNT(DISTINCT course_type) AS total_types_per_department
  FROM typed
  GROUP BY department_code
)
SELECT 
  t.term_code,
  t.subject_title,
  t.responsible_faculty_name AS faculty_name,
  t.email_address,
  t.building_name,
  t.room_name,
  t.floor_level,
  t.building_street_address,
  dc.total_types_per_department
FROM typed t
LEFT JOIN dept_counts dc USING (department_code)
ORDER BY t.department_code, t.subject_title
LIMIT 50;
"""
db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, sql7)
